verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no official crawler or data connectors for Typesense. The docs say users push data they already have, from their primary database, CSV/JSON files, or content crawled with a scraper, which means users must build the ingestion pipeline themselves. The Cloud MCP server, which lets an AI agent index data, and the Postgres migration guide are adjacent features, not first-party crawlers or connectors.

support.subject: As a founder, I can ingest content with an official crawler or connectors instead of writing my own indexing pipeline
